// Fixture — should NOT be flagged.
//
// None of these function names appear in ForbiddenNames. They are
// closed-set enum validators, URL validators, and similar adjacent
// helpers the rule deliberately permits.

package fixture

func isValidStage(id string) bool { return id != "" }

func isValidOutcome(o string) bool { return o != "" }

func isValidBundleName(name string) bool { return name != "" }

func isValidPostMessageOrigin(s string) bool { return s != "" }

func isValidCustomElementTag(tag string) bool { return tag != "" }
